scientific_integrity: The claim is presented as a new structural corollary of a published irrational seed, published subalgebra closure, and McNaughton's theorem; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the continuous ordinary-product expansion under the source paper's random finite-model semantics. It does not classify the full almost-sure spectrum, resolve the pure Łukasiewicz irrational-value question, or handle the discontinuous product residuum.
title: A single product seed forces a dense quadratic-irrational almost-sure spectrum
